name: Nemata
description: A Magnigoth Treefolk in Yavimaya in which Rith was imprisoned by the green Numena.

description_citations.text: "Rith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rith is imprisoned in Nemata; the Weatherlight drives Crosis back into his tar pit and crashes; Karn emerges with the Thran Tome claiming to know how to save the world.
timeline.quote: then Karn emerges with the Thran Tome , saying he knows what to do to save the world.

citation.text: "Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rith, imprisoned in Nemata by the Numena, is freed first by Darigaaz.
timeline.quote: The primeval dragon Rith was originally imprisoned inside Nemata in Yavimaya by the Numena

citation.text: "Nemata", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nemata and the magnigoths travel from Yavimaya to Urborg to recapture Rith; the lead treefolk swallows her.
timeline.quote: The lead treefolk ripped her out of the sky and swallowed her before returning to Yavimaya.

citation.text: "Nemata", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rith escapes during the Second Phyrexian Invasion and Nemata wakes his fellow treefolk to recapture her.
timeline.quote: Rith's sudden escape during the Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria left Nemata furious

timeline.summary: During the Fall of the Primevals, Rith is imprisoned inside the Magnigoth Treefolk Nemata by the green Numena.
timeline.quote: she was imprisoned inside the Magnigoth Treefolk Nemata in Yavimaya by the green Numena
